(* k_trap = (4 * pi^2 * f^2 / c^2) * V_p * (5/6) * (p_rms^2 / (rho_0 * c_0^2)) *)
IF (rSoundSpeedCalculated_mps > 100.0) AND (rGasDensity_kgm3 > 0.0005) THEN
    rAcousticTrapStiffness_Npm := (4.0 * 3.14159265 * 3.14159265 * rPiezoFreq_kHz * 1000.0 * rPiezoFreq_kHz * 1000.0)
                                 / (rSoundSpeedCalculated_mps * rSoundSpeedCalculated_mps)
                                 * (4.18879 * rParticleMeanRadius_m * rParticleMeanRadius_m * rParticleMeanRadius_m)
                                 * (rAcousticPressure_Pa * rAcousticPressure_Pa)
                                 / (rGasDensity_kgm3 * rSoundSpeedCalculated_mps * rSoundSpeedCalculated_mps);
    (* Cap trap stiffness metric to sensible numerical bounds *)
    IF rAcousticTrapStiffness_Npm > 10.0 THEN
        rAcousticTrapStiffness_Npm := 10.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rAcousticTrapStiffness_Npm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Sublimation Flux Estimation [g/min] (Knudsen Ice Vapor Sublimation Kinetics) *)
IF (rVotedCryoTemp_DegC < -20.0) AND (rChamberPress_Filtered_mbar < 2.0) THEN
    (* Driving differential between saturation ice vapor pressure and chamber vacuum *)
    rSublimationFlux_gmin := (2.50 * rPowderFeedRate_gmin * (1.0 - (rChamberPress_Filtered_mbar / 6.11)))
                            * (1.0 + (ABS(rVotedCryoTemp_DegC - (-50.0)) * 0.012));
    IF rSublimationFlux_gmin < 0.0 THEN
        rSublimationFlux_gmin := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rSublimationFlux_gmin := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: STATE-SPACE DISCRETE MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL ENGINE (50 ms RECURSION)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update State Vector Deviations x = [x1, x2, x3, x4]^T *)
rState_x1_NodeDev_um    := rNodeDisp_Filtered_um - rTargetNodePosition_um;
rState_x2_TempErr_DegC  := rVotedCryoTemp_DegC - rTargetCryoTemp_DegC;
rState_x3_PressErr_mbar := rChamberPress_Filtered_mbar - rTargetSublimPressure_mbar;

(* Acoustic Trap Integrity Index (Normalized well depth: 1.0=Rigid, <0.4=Unstable Trap) *)
IF (rTransducerSPL_Filtered_dB >= 155.0) AND bAcousticPllLocked AND (ABS(rNodeDisp_Filtered_um) < 150.0) THEN
    rState_x4_TrapIntegrity := 1.15 - (ABS(rNodeDisp_Filtered_um) / 1000.0);
ELSE
    rState_x4_TrapIntegrity := 0.35;
    udiTrapInstabilityEvents := udiTrapInstabilityEvents + 1;
END_IF;

(* One-Step Receding Horizon State Projections: x_proj = A * x *)
rPredNodeHorizon_um   := (rA11 * rState_x1_NodeDev_um) + (rA12 * rState_x2_TempErr_DegC)
                       + (rA13 * rState_x3_PressErr_mbar) + (rA14 * rState_x4_TrapIntegrity);

rPredTempHorizon_DegC := (rA21 * rState_x1_NodeDev_um) + (rA22 * rState_x2_TempErr_DegC)
                       + (rA23 * rState_x3_PressErr_mbar);

rPredPressHorizon_mbar:= (rA32 * rState_x2_TempErr_DegC) + (rA33 * rState_x3_PressErr_mbar);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_INIT_CALIBRATION: Acoustic Resonator Diagnostic & Cavity Pre-Alignment *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;
        rTransducerPwr_Pct          := 15.0;  (* Low-power resonance probe drive *)
        rFrequencyMod_kHz           := 0.0;

        rVacuumThrottle_Pct         := 0.0;   (* Sealed at atmospheric pressure *)

                wAlarmWord.4 := FALSE; (* Clear Calibration Fault *)

            ELSE
                wAlarmWord.4 := TRUE;  (* Alarm Bit 4: Acoustic Resonance Lock Failure *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_STANDBY_CRYO_CHILL: Nitrogen Flush, Cavity Pre-Cooling to -120 deg C *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;

        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0010;

        (* Engage acoustic standing wave at holding power *)
        rTransducerPwr_Pct          := 45.0;

        IF rVotedCryoTemp_DegC > -120.0 THEN

            IF rCryoGasValve_Pct > 100.0 THEN
                rCryoGasValve_Pct := 100.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rCryoGasValve_Pct := 20.0; (* Base trickle cooling *)
        END_IF;

        (* Temperature-Compensated PZT Cavity Spacing Tracking *)
        (* Delta_L = (n * lambda / 2) - L_0: Compensate shrinking wavelength as sound slows down *)
        rReflectorPZT_um := 75.0 + ((14.2 - rWavelength_mm) * 12.5);
        IF rReflectorPZT_um > 150.0 THEN
            rReflectorPZT_um := 150.0;
        ELSIF rReflectorPZT_um < 0.0 THEN
            rReflectorPZT_um := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        END_IF;

        IF (rVotedCryoTemp_DegC <= -120.0) AND bMasterEnable AND bAutoModeSelect AND NOT bCollectorCycloneFull THEN
            wAlarmWord.5 := FALSE;

        ELSIF NOT bMasterEnable THEN

        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_ACTIVE_LEVITATION_FREEZE: Continuous Droplet Injection, Node Trapping & Vitrification *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := (iHealthySensorCount < 3) OR NOT bAcousticPllLocked;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0020;

        (* Boost power to maintain trap depth proportional to feed rate and displacement error *)
        rTransducerPwr_Pct := 75.0 + (rPowderFeedRate_gmin * 0.35) - (rPredNodeHorizon_um * 0.08);
        IF rTransducerPwr_Pct > 98.0 THEN
            rTransducerPwr_Pct := 98.0; (* Transducer thermal protection ceiling *)
        ELSIF rTransducerPwr_Pct < 40.0 THEN

        END_IF;

        rFrequencyMod_kHz := -(rPredNodeHorizon_um * 0.0025);

            rFrequencyMod_kHz := 2.50;
        ELSIF rFrequencyMod_kHz < -2.50 THEN
            rFrequencyMod_kHz := -2.50;
        END_IF;

        rReflectorPZT_um := 75.0 + ((14.2 - rWavelength_mm) * 14.0) + (rPredNodeHorizon_um * 0.05);
        IF rReflectorPZT_um > 150.0 THEN
            rReflectorPZT_um := 150.0;
        ELSIF rReflectorPZT_um < 0.0 THEN

        rCryoGasValve_Pct := 40.0 + (rPredTempHorizon_DegC * 0.65) + (rPowderFeedRate_gmin * 0.85);
        IF rCryoGasValve_Pct > 100.0 THEN
            rCryoGasValve_Pct := 100.0;
        ELSIF rCryoGasValve_Pct < 15.0 THEN
            rCryoGasValve_Pct := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        rVacuumThrottle_Pct       := 5.0;
        rPowderDischargeRate_gmin := 0.0;

        rCumulativePowderFrozen_kg := rCumulativePowderFrozen_kg + ((rPowderFeedRate_gmin * 0.05) / 60000.0);
        rCumulativeLN2Consumed_kg  := rCumulativeLN2Consumed_kg  + ((rCryoGasValve_Pct * 0.05 * 0.02) / 60.0);

        IF (rVotedCryoTemp_DegC <= -135.0) AND (rCumulativePowderFrozen_kg > 0.005) AND bVacuumPumpRunning THEN
            iState := 30; (* Advance to Vacuum Sublimation Phase *)
        ELSIF (rState_x4_TrapIntegrity < 0.30) OR (ABS(rNodeDisp_Filtered_um) > 400.0) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Node instability: Degraded fallback *)
        ELSIF bCollectorCycloneFull THEN

        END_IF;

        bSystemReady                := TRUE;

        rVacuumThrottle_Pct := 50.0 + (rPredPressHorizon_mbar * 120.0);

        IF rTransducerPwr_Pct > 90.0 THEN
            rTransducerPwr_Pct := 90.0;
        ELSIF rTransducerPwr_Pct < 35.0 THEN
            rTransducerPwr_Pct := 35.0;
        END_IF;

        rReflectorPZT_um := 75.0 + ((14.2 - rWavelength_mm) * 14.0);
        IF rReflectorPZT_um > 150.0 THEN

        ELSIF rReflectorPZT_um < 0.0 THEN

        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_POWDER_HARVEST_CONVEY: Downward Acoustic Traveling Wave & Cyclone Transfer *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;

        rFrequencyMod_kHz           := -1.85; (* Controlled downward frequency glide *)
        rTransducerPwr_Pct          := 40.0;  (* Controlled reduction of potential well depth *)
        rReflectorPZT_um            := 20.0;  (* Retract reflector to expand nodal spacing *)
        rCryoGasValve_Pct           := 15.0;
        rVacuumThrottle_Pct         := 25.0;  (* Controlled slight pressure rise to sweep particles *)

        rPowderDischargeRate_gmin   := 15.0 + (rPowderFeedRate_gmin * 0.95);

    50: (* STATE_DEGRADED_FALLBACK: Acoustic PLL Lost or Sensor Failure - Controlled Run-Down *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0050;

        rTransducerPwr_Pct          := 55.0;
        rFrequencyMod_kHz           := 0.0;
        rReflectorPZT_um            := 75.0;
        rCryoGasValve_Pct           := 35.0;  (* Constant safe cooling *)
        rVacuumThrottle_Pct         := 15.0;
        rPowderDischargeRate_gmin   := 5.0;   (* Slow evacuation of current chamber inventory *)

        (* Evaluate Recovery Criteria *)
        IF bAcousticPllLocked AND (iHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND (ABS(rNodeDisp_Filtered_um) < 100.0) AND bAutoModeSelect THEN
            wAlarmWord.6 := FALSE;

        ELSIF NOT bMasterEnable OR (rState_x4_TrapIntegrity < 0.15) THEN

        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_CRITICAL_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN: System Isolation & Sterile N2 Vacuum Break *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;
        rTransducerPwr_Pct          := 0.0;
        rFrequencyMod_kHz           := 0.0;
        rReflectorPZT_um            := 0.0;
        rCryoGasValve_Pct           := 0.0;
        rVacuumThrottle_Pct         := 0.0;
        rPowderDischargeRate_gmin   := 0.0;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#9999;
        wAlarmWord.1                := TRUE;  (* Alarm Bit 1: Emergency Trip Active *)

        (* Safe Recovery Permissive: E-Stop Healthy, Chamber Pressure > 800 mbar, Master Reset *)
        IF bSafetyEStopOk AND (rChamberPress_Filtered_mbar > 800.0) AND NOT bCollectorCycloneFull THEN

IF (rVotedCryoTemp_DegC > -30.0) AND (iState = 20) THEN

    wAlarmWord.8 := FALSE;

IF (rChamberPress_Filtered_mbar > 3.50) AND (iState = 30) THEN
